title: Principal
description: A tenant principal (a person, an external program or system) with identities and group memberships. A principal lives in one tenant; the verification code and keys are stored only as hashes (IDN-4). Only the core writes the records, on P2 operations (IDN-1).

external.description: Identity in the channel: telegram:<id>, api:<key_id>, hook:<source> or email:<address> (IDN-1).

key_id.description: Key id of an external program; the key itself is stored only as a hash.

strength.description: Identity assurance: decisions on cards only from a strong one (APR-4).

state.description: Membership of a privileged group is pending until the verification code is checked (PRM-13).

requested_by.description: Admin of the production tenant who requested the grant in writing (--requested-by).

delegated.description: A group from the tenant's delegated_groups, granted by an admin (PRM-16).

id.description: Opaque principal id: for a person human:p_<ULID>. The id does not change and contains no name; after the person leaves, the core records and the audit keep the same id.

name.description: The person's name for cards and messages. References to a principal in core records contain no name; on transition to offboarded the field is deleted together with the identities (LCY-3).

kind.description: Principal kind: a person, an external program or the service principal system (IDN-1).

state.description: Principal state by the LCY-3 lifecycle: active works, off is disabled by the /off command (reversible), offboarded has left for good through P2 principal.offboard (the core writes it from v0.1, D-98; it cannot be left).

verification_code_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the form sha256:<64 hex digits>.

uploads_personal.description: Files of this principal get personal_seen with the source declared (AUD-5).

prefs.description: From v0.2: notification preferences of a person (DLV-10). They only defer deliveries of kinds marked deferrable in delivery-kinds.yaml or collect them into a digest. Set by the person with /prefs or by an admin with admin:people; the language is the field locale.

quiet_hours.description: Local time interval of the person's tenant time zone; from may be later than to (over midnight).

digest.description: daily collects deferrable deliveries into one message a day.
